_about: Up or down from the platform, for the station maps' 'u' routes (stairs, lift or escalator to an entrance hall above or below), from the readers' notes (November 22nd 2026). Per station: platform (or '*' for the rest) to 'up', 'down' or 'unknown' (the map doesn't show which: the sentence then says only where the way out leads). Applied by build_exits_table.py; a station or platform not listed keeps its kind's word (all 'above': up; all 'below': down).
